title: Quest Express Boat Club
seo_title: Quest Express Boat Club | Ottawa, IL
seo_description: Join Quest Express Boat Club at Heritage Harbor in Ottawa, IL. Boat the Illinois River with no loan, maintenance or storage. Weekday, Family and Buddy plans.
body_html:
Experience boating at Heritage Harbor with a boat club in Ottawa, IL, without the cost, maintenance or stress of ownership. Instead of worrying about storage, repairs or prep work, you reserve your boat, show up and enjoy your day on the water.

All the Best Parts of Boating, None of the Ownership Stress

Quest Express gives you the freedom to enjoy boating all season long while we handle the maintenance, storage, repairs, prep and upkeep behind the scenes. You get more time on the water and far less hassle on land.

  • No ownership costs. No loan, no depreciation and no surprise repair bills.
  • No maintenance or storage. We handle cleaning, repairs, winterizing and storage.
  • Access to multiple boats. Choose the right boat for relaxing, cruising, watersports or family time.
  • Reserve. Arrive. Go. Your boat is ready when you are.

How It Works

  1. Tour the fleet and marina. Come see the boats, the marina and how membership works.
  2. Join the club. Choose the membership option that best fits your lifestyle and schedule.
  3. Complete on-water training. We make sure you feel confident and comfortable before you head out.
  4. Reserve and enjoy. Reserve your boat and spend your summer boating.

Schedule a tour

Your Summer, On the Water

From tubing with the kids to quiet sunset cruises, every day on the water looks a little different, and that is exactly the point. Bring your family and friends, or take a spontaneous afternoon cruise. With Quest Express, boating becomes part of your lifestyle instead of a project you have to manage.

A Boat for Every Kind of Day

Whether you want a relaxed family cruise, an afternoon of tubing or a more performance-driven ride, the fleet is built for variety.

Relax and Cruise

Spacious pontoons are perfect for family time, entertaining and leisurely days on the river.

Adventure and Watersports

Tritoons and sport-ready boats are ideal for tubing, wakeboarding and action-packed afternoons.

Performance and Fun

For the days when you want a little more excitement and speed.

Why the Illinois River Changes Everything

Boating here is different, in the best way. Members enjoy a scenic, easy and refreshingly uncrowded experience, boating from Heritage Harbor Ottawa in the heart of Starved Rock Country.

  • Calmer waters with less congestion
  • Miles of uninterrupted boating
  • Scenic cliffs, bluffs and natural beauty
  • Great conditions for watersports and cruising
  • Easy access to Ottawa dining, shopping and nearby attractions

Read more about boating the Illinois River. Learn about Heritage Harbor Ottawa, explore Starved Rock State Park, or check out the Ottawa Visitors Center.

Choose the Membership That Fits Your Life

Quest Express offers membership options for different schedules, families and boating styles.

Weekday

Relaxed, flexible and crowd-free.

  • Monday to Friday access
  • 2 advanced reservations
  • 24-hour last-minute booking
  • 2 captains (same household)
  • On-water training included
  • Access to Heritage Harbor resort amenities
  • Marina pool and beach access

Family

The most flexible all-around option.

  • 7 days a week availability
  • 2 advanced reservations
  • 24-hour last-minute booking
  • 2 captains (same household)
  • On-water training included
  • Access to Heritage Harbor resort amenities
  • Marina pool and beach access

Buddy

Share the freedom and the cost.

  • 7 days a week availability
  • 2 advanced reservations
  • 24-hour last-minute booking
  • 2 captains (different households)
  • On-water training included
  • Access to Heritage Harbor resort amenities
  • Marina pool and beach access

Additional captains may be added for an additional fee. Contact our team for current pricing and membership details.

See If Quest Express Is Right for You

Tour the marina, explore the fleet and discover how easy boating can be when the hard part is already handled. Whether you are just getting started or ready to join, we would love to show you around.

Schedule a tour or email our team.

faqs.q: Who can join Quest Express Boat Club?
faqs.a: Anyone who is 21 or older and has a valid Illinois driver's license.

faqs.q: Do I need boating experience to join?
faqs.a: No. We provide orientation for all Club Members, guiding you through handling the boats, launching from the marina and boating on the Illinois waterway.

The Club provides an online reservation system you can use any time. Once you become a Member you receive a user name and password. Select the boat style and date and click to reserve. Reservations can be made from 2 hours to 30 days in advance.

faqs.q: Are there any daily use charges?
faqs.a: No. The only recurring costs other than membership fees are for the fuel you use. Concierge services such as catering or boat guide coaching are available at additional fees.
No. Quest Express maintains a Club policy that covers major damage and liability.
Just call us at 815.433.2200. We will set a time to tour the marina, see the fleet, review the Membership Agreement, schedule your orientation and get you out on the water.
